measurements.evidence_quote: The particle size distributions of PS-NPs in water and cell culture medium were 33±8 nm and 35±8 nm, respectively. The zeta potentials of PS-NPs in water and cell culture medium were -29.6±2.6 mV and -8.93±0.16 mV, respectively. || The size distribution of Ag-NPs and PS-NPs suspended in deionized water and the zeta-potential were determined using a Malvern Zeta Sizer Nano ZS (Malvern Instruments, Malvern, UK).
